identity.name: NordicForge
identity.description: A unified business management platform merging construction field work with high-precision accounting. The aesthetic is 'Steel & Paper'—robust structure with clean documentation.

heading.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and metric values. Tracking should be tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, table data, and inputs.

mono.family: SF Mono, Monaco, Consolas, Fira Mono, monospace
mono.usage: Use for invoice numbers, API keys, and financial tabular data alignment.

colors.theme_strategy: Hybrid: Light Mode default for Data/Documents, Dark Mode optional. Default to Light Mode for initial build as per business standard.

primary.description: Deep Nordic Navy. Use for Sidebar, Main Headers, and Primary Branding.

accent.description: Safety Orange. MANDATORY for Primary Actions (Create, Save, Pay). High visibility.

background.description: Slate-50 for Light Mode (Paper feel), Slate-950 for Dark Mode (Night Shift).

surface.description: Pure white for cards in light mode. Contrast is key.

gradients.forbidden: No full-screen gradients. No gradient text.
gradients.allowed: Subtle top-to-bottom fade on the Sidebar (Slate-900 to Slate-950).

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: The Bento Grid (Mode B - High Density)

inputs.style: h-9 bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent/20 rounded-md

tables.header: bg-muted/50 font-medium text-muted-foreground h-10 text-left px-4

visual_enhancers.texture: Use a subtle noise texture (opacity 0.02) on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'divide-y' and 'border' utilities frequently. Structure is key for accounting.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use minimalist outlined icons or ASCII-style representations for empty states. No cartoony illustrations.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Stroke width 1.5px (Thin/Elegant).

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPERATIVE: Implement a 'Layout' component that handles the Sidebar and Topbar structure. Do not repeat navigation in every page.
IMPERATIVE: The 'Dashboard' must use a CSS Grid (Bento style). Do not just stack cards vertically.
IMPERATIVE: Use the 'Safety Orange' (#FF4500) SPARINGLY. Only for the most important button on the screen.
IMPERATIVE: For 'Invoices' and 'Payroll', strictly use Tables. Do not use Cards for list items.
IMPERATIVE: Ensure 'Light Mode' is the default appearance, but keep 'Dark Mode' classes available via the 'dark' class on HTML/Body.
IMPERATIVE: All financial data should be right-aligned in tables.
IMPERATIVE: Use 'Space Grotesk' for headers to give it that 'Technical/Blueprint' feel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers only.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays for backgrounds.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
